sloka: अवेक्स्याञ्जलिपानाम्श्च ब्राह्मणान् वेदपारगान् ।ययुर्मध्येन बाह्लीकान् सुदामानम् च पर्वतम् ॥२-६८-१८॥
transliteration: aveksyāñjalipānāmśca brāhmaṇān vedapāragān ।yayurmadhyena bāhlīkān sudāmānam ca parvatam ॥2-68-18॥

translations.english: There they saw the brahmins versed in the Vedas and drank water with cupped palms. Then they continued their journey through the middle of Bahlika country, and reached Sudama mountain.
